text:
maria.p: Quick internal: were GAing the HorizonRT realtime family + Smart Failover for hosted API today. New streaming path and routing headers included. :tada:

kai: Nice. Any immediate actions for teams?

maria.p: Dev teams: smoke test your realtime flows against the canary. Default routing allows failover; set header x-rw-routing-policy: "no-fallback" to opt out.

devex: Quick sample curl (stream):

```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" \
  -H "x-rw-routing-policy: prefer-low-latency" \
  -d '{"model":"horizonrt-medium","input":"hi"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/realtime/stream
```

ops-bot: rollout 1857.01 started (maria.p)  canary 5% us-east-1. Dashboard: https://deploy.redwood.ai/1857.01

kai: Are there breaking changes for existing realtime consumers?

maria.p: No breaking changes. Old realtime endpoints still work. We are deprecating the legacy fallback query param in favor of the routing header (90-day deprecation).

eng-oncall: Oncall will monitor canary for 72h. Alert if p95 > baseline * 1.5 or error-rate spikes.

product: We'll publish the customer-facing release notes and changelog entry today. Marketing + CS looped in.

maria.p: Thanks — please file any canary issues in the rollout board and ping eng-oncall. Appreciate quick smoke tests. :rocket:
